description: A blue-covered bed with a pale pillow is in front, and a small white plastic chair-like stand sits near the center with a loose white piece beside it. The left hand stays braced on the lower part of the stand to steady it while the right hand reaches in from the right, grips a small rectangular insert on the stand’s front, pulls it outward and slightly right, and lifts it away, leaving the insert as a right-hand object while the stand remains a left-hand object.
